## Checklist

- [ ] The source code is public and the license in the YAML file matches the repository's license
- [ ] The file is named `<package>.yml` and sits in `apps/`
- [ ] The latest GitHub Release has a **signed** release APK attached
- [ ] The APK is built from the public source code (no closed-source parts)
- [ ] The app contains no ads, trackers or analytics, or they are clearly described in the description
- [ ] I understand updates must always be signed with the same key
